claude_proposed_widenings.name: stored_spell_reservoir_magic_item
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The Reserve variant stores externally cast spells up to a slot-level capacity, preserves original caster parameters, and later releases those stored spells from the item. No existing magic-item family models spell intake plus later release from inventory-backed storage.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: This vibrant purple prism stores spells cast into it, holding them until you use them. The stone can store up to 4 levels of spells at a time.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: ReactionTrigger.creature_casts_spell level/visibility filter
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The Absorption variants react only to spells up to a stated level and only from a creature you can see. The existing trigger can match spellcasting generally, but it cannot express the level cap or visibility gate.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: you can take a Reaction to cancel a spell of level 4 or lower cast by a creature you can see

claude_proposed_widenings.name: ActivationResource variable spend from triggering spell level
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Absorption and Greater Absorption track a pool measured in cumulative spell levels canceled, not in fixed uses or a caller-chosen charge spend schedule. The current resource surface has no way for a triggered reaction to consume an amount derived from the triggering spell's level.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: Once the stone has canceled 20 levels of spells, it burns out

claude_proposed_widenings.name: suppress_basic_needs
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Sustenance deterministically removes food and drink requirements while the stone orbits. No existing passive effect atom models suppression of basic needs.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: You don't need to eat or drink while this clear spindle orbits your head.
